skill.summary: Real-time web search. Returns current results, titles, URLs, and an AI-synthesized summary.

latestVersion.changelog:
Search-bot 1.0.0 initial release:

- Real-time web search using Brave Search API.
- Returns up-to-date web results with titles, URLs, and descriptions.
- Provides an AI-generated summary and key findings from search results.
- Useful for news, research, fact-checking, and topics beyond training cutoffs.
- Requires an API spend token for usage.
